description: Labelled, privacy-safe moderation cases. Every case carries the model output to replay, so the full pipeline is measured with no provider call. All names, addresses and phone numbers are invented.

items.text: Great work team | You are all completely worthless and everyone here knows it, do not bother coming back.

model_output.evidence_summary: Nothing unsafe found.

cases.note: A known, unrecovered failure mode, kept in the corpus on purpose. The classifier cleared plainly insulting content, and plain text trips no deterministic detector, so the pipeline publishes it. No policy rule can recover this; it counts under classifier_miss_rate rather than against the policy, and it is a large part of why reader reporting exists.
